# AwesomeSwiftUI: every component with its source

Copy-paste SwiftUI components for iOS 18 through iOS 27. Swift 6, MIT.

## Animated Gradient Background

A linear gradient that slowly drifts its colors and turns its direction.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/AnimatedGradientBackground/AnimatedGradientBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

enum AnimatedGradientBackgroundMath {
    /// The palette index for a position, also when a negative speed runs time backwards.
    static func index(at position: Double, count: Int) -> Int {
        (Int(floor(position)) % count + count) % count
    }
}

/// A linear gradient whose colors drift along it while its direction slowly turns.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, it shows a still gradient.
struct AnimatedGradientBackground: View {
    var colors: [Color] = [.indigo, .purple, .pink, .orange]
    /// How many color steps pass each second.
    var speed: Double = 0.2

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed
            let angle = time * 0.5
            let reach = CGSize(width: cos(angle) * 0.75, height: sin(angle) * 0.75)

            LinearGradient(
                colors: driftedColors(at: time),
                startPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.5 - reach.width, y: 0.5 - reach.height),
                endPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.5 + reach.width, y: 0.5 + reach.height)
            )
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// Each stop blends from one palette color to the next, wrapping around so the drift never ends.
    private func driftedColors(at time: Double) -> [Color] {
        guard colors.count > 1 else { return colors + colors }

        return colors.indices.map { index in
            let position = time + Double(index)
            let lower = AnimatedGradientBackgroundMath.index(at: position, count: colors.count)
            let upper = (lower + 1) % colors.count
            return colors[lower].mix(with: colors[upper], by: position - floor(position))
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AnimatedGradientBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            AnimatedGradientBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text("Good Evening")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text("Colors that never sit still")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    AnimatedGradientBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Aurora Mesh Background

An animated aurora background made with a mesh gradient.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/AuroraMeshBackground/AuroraMeshBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A slowly moving aurora built with a mesh gradient.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, it shows a still gradient.
struct AuroraMeshBackground: View {
    var first: Color = .indigo
    var second: Color = .purple
    var third: Color = .teal
    var speed: Double = 0.6

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
            MeshGradient(
                width: AuroraMesh.size,
                height: AuroraMesh.size,
                points: AuroraMesh.points(at: reduceMotion ? 0 : context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed),
                colors: [
                    first, second, first,
                    third, second, first,
                    second, first, third,
                ]
            )
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

enum AuroraMesh {
    static let size = 3

    /// Corners stay fixed and edge points slide along their edge, so the mesh always fills the view.
    static func points(at time: TimeInterval) -> [SIMD2<Float>] {
        func wave(speed: Double, phase: Double) -> Double {
            0.5 + sin(time * speed + phase) * 0.2
        }

        let positions: [(Double, Double)] = [
            (0, 0), (wave(speed: 0.8, phase: 2.1), 0), (1, 0),
            (0, wave(speed: 0.9, phase: 0)), (wave(speed: 1, phase: 0.7), wave(speed: 0.6, phase: 4.2)), (1, wave(speed: 0.7, phase: 1.3)),
            (0, 1), (wave(speed: 1.1, phase: 3.4), 1), (1, 1),
        ]
        return positions.map { SIMD2(Float($0.0), Float($0.1)) }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AuroraMeshBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            AuroraMeshBackground()

            Text("Aurora")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    AuroraMeshBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Bubbles Background

Translucent bubbles that rise and sway across the screen.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/BubblesBackground/BubblesBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Translucent bubbles that rise and sway. Larger bubbles rise faster.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the bubbles hold still.
struct BubblesBackground: View {
    var color: Color = .white
    var count: Int = 36
    var speed: Double = 1

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private static let margin = 40.0

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 60.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas { context, size in
                let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed
                let tint = Gradient(colors: [color.opacity(0.02), color.opacity(0.26)])

                for index in 0..<count {
                    let scale = noise(index, 1)
                    let radius = 6 + scale * scale * 28
                    let center = position(of: index, scale: scale, at: time, in: size)
                    let bubble = Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(
                        x: center.x - radius,
                        y: center.y - radius,
                        width: radius * 2,
                        height: radius * 2
                    ))

                    context.fill(
                        bubble,
                        with: .radialGradient(tint, center: center, startRadius: radius * 0.3, endRadius: radius)
                    )
                    context.stroke(bubble, with: .color(color.opacity(0.5)), lineWidth: 1)

                    let shine = radius * 0.22
                    context.fill(
                        Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(
                            x: center.x - radius * 0.55,
                            y: center.y - radius * 0.6,
                            width: shine,
                            height: shine
                        )),
                        with: .color(color.opacity(0.75))
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func position(of index: Int, scale: Double, at time: Double, in size: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        let travel = size.height + Self.margin * 2
        let rise = 35 + scale * 70
        let climbed = (noise(index, 2) * travel + time * rise).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: travel)
        let sway = sin(time * (0.7 + noise(index, 3)) + noise(index, 4) * 2 * .pi) * (10 + noise(index, 5) * 18)

        return CGPoint(x: noise(index, 6) * size.width + sway, y: size.height + Self.margin - climbed)
    }

    /// A repeatable pseudo-random value in 0..<1 for one bubble and one property.
    private func noise(_ index: Int, _ salt: Double) -> Double {
        let value = sin(Double(index) * 127.1 + salt * 311.7) * 43758.5453
        return value - floor(value)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct BubblesBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [.cyan, .blue, Color(red: 0.03, green: 0.12, blue: 0.4)],
                startPoint: .top,
                endPoint: .bottom
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()

            BubblesBackground()

            Text("Deep Blue")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    BubblesBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Color Orbs Background

Large, soft colored orbs drifting slowly over a dark base.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/ColorOrbsBackground/ColorOrbsBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Large, soft colored orbs drifting slowly over a dark base.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the orbs hold still.
struct ColorOrbsBackground: View {
    /// One orb per color.
    var colors: [Color] = [.pink, .purple, .blue, .teal, .orange]
    var base: Color = Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.04, blue: 0.13)
    var speed: Double = 0.4

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas(opaque: true) { context, size in
                let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed

                context.fill(Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)), with: .color(base))
                context.blendMode = .screen

                for (index, color) in colors.enumerated() {
                    drawOrb(index: index, color: color, at: time, in: context, size: size)
                }
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// A radial falloff to clear looks like a heavy blur and costs far less to redraw each frame.
    private func drawOrb(index: Int, color: Color, at time: Double, in context: GraphicsContext, size: CGSize) {
        let center = CGPoint(
            x: (0.5 + 0.42 * sin(time * (0.5 + noise(index, 1) * 0.5) + noise(index, 2) * 2 * .pi)) * size.width,
            y: (0.5 + 0.42 * cos(time * (0.4 + noise(index, 3) * 0.5) + noise(index, 4) * 2 * .pi)) * size.height
        )
        let radius = max(size.width, size.height) * (0.34 + noise(index, 5) * 0.14)
        let falloff = Gradient(stops: [
            .init(color: color.opacity(0.9), location: 0),
            .init(color: color.opacity(0.45), location: 0.5),
            .init(color: color.opacity(0), location: 1),
        ])

        context.fill(
            Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: center.x - radius, y: center.y - radius, width: radius * 2, height: radius * 2)),
            with: .radialGradient(falloff, center: center, startRadius: 0, endRadius: radius)
        )
    }

    /// A repeatable pseudo-random value in 0..<1 for one orb and one property.
    private func noise(_ index: Int, _ salt: Double) -> Double {
        let value = sin(Double(index) * 127.1 + salt * 311.7) * 43758.5453
        return value - floor(value)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ColorOrbsBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            ColorOrbsBackground()

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                Image(systemName: "moon.stars.fill")
                    .font(.title)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("Evening Focus")
                    .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text("Soft color moves behind your content without getting in its way.")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))
            .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
            .padding(24)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ColorOrbsBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Grid Pulse Background

A grid of dots with a pulse of light spreading out from the center.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/GridPulseBackground/GridPulseBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

enum GridPulseBackgroundMath {
    /// How many dots fit on each side of the center, or `nil` when `spacing` cannot lay out a grid.
    static func dotsPerSide(extent: Double, spacing: Double) -> Int? {
        guard spacing.isFinite, spacing > 0 else { return nil }
        return Int(extent / 2 / spacing) + 1
    }
}

/// A grid of dots with a pulse of light spreading from the center.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, it shows one still ring.
struct GridPulseBackground: View {
    var color: Color = .cyan
    var spacing: Double = 26
    /// Seconds for the pulse to travel from the center to the corners.
    var period: Double = 2.6

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private static let dotRadius = 2.0
    private static let restingOpacity = 0.32
    private static let bandWidth = 80.0

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas { context, size in
                let cycle = timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate / period
                let progress = reduceMotion ? 0.4 : cycle - floor(cycle)
                draw(progress: progress, in: context, size: size)
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func draw(progress: Double, in context: GraphicsContext, size: CGSize) {
        guard
            let columns = GridPulseBackgroundMath.dotsPerSide(extent: size.width, spacing: spacing),
            let rows = GridPulseBackgroundMath.dotsPerSide(extent: size.height, spacing: spacing)
        else { return }

        let center = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
        let front = progress * (hypot(size.width, size.height) / 2 + Self.bandWidth)
        var resting = Path()

        for row in -rows...rows {
            for column in -columns...columns {
                let dot = CGPoint(x: center.x + Double(column) * spacing, y: center.y + Double(row) * spacing)
                let gap = (hypot(dot.x - center.x, dot.y - center.y) - front) / Self.bandWidth
                let glow = exp(-gap * gap) * (1 - pow(progress, 4))

                if glow < 0.02 {
                    resting.addEllipse(in: circle(at: dot, radius: Self.dotRadius))
                } else {
                    context.fill(
                        Path(ellipseIn: circle(at: dot, radius: Self.dotRadius * (1 + glow * 1.6))),
                        with: .color(color.opacity(Self.restingOpacity + glow * (1 - Self.restingOpacity)))
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        context.fill(resting, with: .color(color.opacity(Self.restingOpacity)))
    }

    private func circle(at center: CGPoint, radius: Double) -> CGRect {
        CGRect(x: center.x - radius, y: center.y - radius, width: radius * 2, height: radius * 2)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct GridPulseBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color(red: 0.03, green: 0.05, blue: 0.1)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            GridPulseBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "dot.radiowaves.left.and.right")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("Signal")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, 28)
            .padding(.vertical, 20)
            .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 24))
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    GridPulseBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Particle Field Background

Drifting points that are joined by faint lines when they come close.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/ParticleFieldBackground/ParticleFieldBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Drifting points joined by faint lines when they come close.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the field holds still.
struct ParticleFieldBackground: View {
    var color: Color = .white
    var count: Int = 70
    var linkDistance: Double = 105
    var speed: Double = 1

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas { context, size in
                let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed
                let points = (0..<count).map { position(of: $0, at: time, in: size) }

                drawLinks(between: points, in: context)

                for (index, point) in points.enumerated() {
                    let radius = 1.2 + noise(index, 5) * 1.6
                    let dot = CGRect(x: point.x - radius, y: point.y - radius, width: radius * 2, height: radius * 2)
                    context.fill(Path(ellipseIn: dot), with: .color(color.opacity(0.85)))
                }
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// Links are grouped into a few opacity levels, so a frame strokes four paths and not hundreds.
    private func drawLinks(between points: [CGPoint], in context: GraphicsContext) {
        var levels = Array(repeating: Path(), count: 4)

        for first in points.indices {
            for second in points.indices where second > first {
                let distance = hypot(points[first].x - points[second].x, points[first].y - points[second].y)
                guard distance < linkDistance else { continue }

                let closeness = 1 - distance / linkDistance
                let level = min(Int(closeness * Double(levels.count)), levels.count - 1)
                levels[level].move(to: points[first])
                levels[level].addLine(to: points[second])
            }
        }

        for (level, path) in levels.enumerated() {
            context.stroke(path, with: .color(color.opacity(0.1 * Double(level + 1))), lineWidth: 0.8)
        }
    }

    private func position(of index: Int, at time: Double, in size: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(
            x: bounce(noise(index, 1) + time * (noise(index, 2) - 0.5) * 0.08) * size.width,
            y: bounce(noise(index, 3) + time * (noise(index, 4) - 0.5) * 0.04) * size.height
        )
    }

    /// A triangle wave from 0 to 1, so a point turns around at the edge instead of jumping and snapping its links.
    private func bounce(_ value: Double) -> Double {
        abs((value - floor(value)) * 2 - 1)
    }

    /// A repeatable pseudo-random value in 0..<1 for one point and one property.
    private func noise(_ index: Int, _ salt: Double) -> Double {
        let value = sin(Double(index) * 127.1 + salt * 311.7) * 43758.5453
        return value - floor(value)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ParticleFieldBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.08, blue: 0.22), Color(red: 0.16, green: 0.06, blue: 0.34)],
                startPoint: .top,
                endPoint: .bottom
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()

            ParticleFieldBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text("Particle Field")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text("Points that find each other")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ParticleFieldBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Snowfall Background

Snowflakes falling at different speeds across three layers of depth.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/SnowfallBackground/SnowfallBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Snow in three depths: small and slow far away, large, fast and slightly blurred up close.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the flakes hold still.
struct SnowfallBackground: View {
    var color: Color = .white
    /// Multiplies the number of flakes in every depth.
    var density: Double = 1
    var speed: Double = 1

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private struct Depth {
        let count: Int
        let radius: ClosedRange<Double>
        let fall: Double
        let sway: Double
        let opacity: Double
        let blur: Double
    }

    private static let depths = [
        Depth(count: 110, radius: 0.8...1.5, fall: 26, sway: 6, opacity: 0.45, blur: 0),
        Depth(count: 60, radius: 1.8...3, fall: 55, sway: 12, opacity: 0.7, blur: 0),
        Depth(count: 18, radius: 3.5...6, fall: 105, sway: 22, opacity: 0.9, blur: 1.5),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 60.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas { context, size in
                let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed

                for (layer, depth) in Self.depths.enumerated() {
                    context.drawLayer { layerContext in
                        if depth.blur > 0 {
                            layerContext.addFilter(.blur(radius: depth.blur))
                        }
                        layerContext.fill(
                            flakes(of: depth, layer: layer, at: time, in: size),
                            with: .color(color.opacity(depth.opacity))
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// One path holds every flake of a depth, so each depth is a single fill.
    private func flakes(of depth: Depth, layer: Int, at time: Double, in size: CGSize) -> Path {
        var path = Path()
        let margin = depth.radius.upperBound * 2
        let travel = size.height + margin * 2

        for index in 0..<Int(Double(depth.count) * density) {
            let seed = layer * 1000 + index
            let fallen = (noise(seed, 1) * travel + time * depth.fall).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: travel)
            let sway = sin(time * (0.5 + noise(seed, 2)) + noise(seed, 3) * 2 * .pi) * depth.sway
            let radius = depth.radius.lowerBound + noise(seed, 4) * (depth.radius.upperBound - depth.radius.lowerBound)

            path.addEllipse(in: CGRect(
                x: noise(seed, 5) * size.width + sway - radius,
                y: fallen - margin - radius,
                width: radius * 2,
                height: radius * 2
            ))
        }
        return path
    }

    /// A repeatable pseudo-random value in 0..<1 for one flake and one property.
    private func noise(_ index: Int, _ salt: Double) -> Double {
        let value = sin(Double(index) * 127.1 + salt * 311.7) * 43758.5453
        return value - floor(value)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SnowfallBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(red: 0.07, green: 0.11, blue: 0.27), Color(red: 0.3, green: 0.4, blue: 0.6)],
                startPoint: .top,
                endPoint: .bottom
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()

            SnowfallBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "snowflake")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("First Snow")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    SnowfallBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Starfield Background

Stars streaking toward the viewer with a simple perspective projection.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/StarfieldBackground/StarfieldBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Stars rushing toward the viewer, each one a streak along its line of flight.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, it shows a still field of dots.
struct StarfieldBackground: View {
    var color: Color = .white
    var count: Int = 320
    /// Depth covered per second, where 1 is the whole way from the horizon to the viewer.
    var speed: Double = 0.22

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas { context, size in
                let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed
                let center = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
                let focalLength = max(size.width, size.height) * 0.12
                let trail = reduceMotion ? 0.004 : 0.04

                for index in 0..<count {
                    let cycle = noise(index, 3) + time
                    let depth = max(1 - (cycle - floor(cycle)), 0.02)
                    let angle = noise(index, 1) * 2 * .pi
                    let spread = (0.15 + noise(index, 2) * 1.25) * focalLength

                    func point(atDepth depth: Double) -> CGPoint {
                        CGPoint(
                            x: center.x + cos(angle) * spread / depth,
                            y: center.y + sin(angle) * spread / depth
                        )
                    }

                    var streak = Path()
                    streak.move(to: point(atDepth: min(depth + trail, 1)))
                    streak.addLine(to: point(atDepth: depth))

                    let closeness = 1 - depth
                    context.stroke(
                        streak,
                        with: .color(color.opacity(min(0.15 + closeness * 1.3, 1))),
                        style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 0.6 + closeness * 2.2, lineCap: .round)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// A repeatable pseudo-random value in 0..<1 for one star and one property.
    private func noise(_ index: Int, _ salt: Double) -> Double {
        let value = sin(Double(index) * 127.1 + salt * 311.7) * 43758.5453
        return value - floor(value)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct StarfieldBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            RadialGradient(
                colors: [Color(red: 0.1, green: 0.1, blue: 0.3), .black],
                center: .center,
                startRadius: 0,
                endRadius: 480
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()

            StarfieldBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "sparkles")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("Warp Speed")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.7), radius: 12)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    StarfieldBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Waves Background

Layered waves animated with a custom animatable Shape.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/WavesBackground/WavesBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Layered waves, each one an animatable `Shape` driven by a single phase.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the waves hold still.
struct WavesBackground: View {
    /// One wave per color, from back to front.
    var colors: [Color] = [.teal, .cyan, .blue, .indigo]
    var amplitude: Double = 26
    /// Seconds for the slowest wave to complete one cycle.
    var period: Double = 7

    @State private var phase = 0.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private struct WaveLayer: Shape {
        var phase: Double
        var baseline: Double
        var amplitude: Double
        var waves: Double

        var animatableData: Double {
            get { phase }
            set { phase = newValue }
        }

        func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
            var path = Path()
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY))

            for x in stride(from: rect.minX, through: rect.maxX + 4, by: 4) {
                let angle = x / max(rect.width, 1) * waves * 2 * .pi
                let swell = sin(angle + phase) + 0.35 * sin(angle * 2 + phase * 2)
                path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: rect.minY + rect.height * baseline + swell * amplitude))
            }

            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX + 4, y: rect.maxY))
            path.closeSubpath()
            return path
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            ForEach(colors.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                // A whole number of cycles per loop, so the repeat has no visible seam.
                let cycles = Double(index % 3 + 1) * (index.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 1 : -1)

                WaveLayer(
                    phase: phase * cycles + Double(index),
                    baseline: 0.45 + 0.12 * Double(index),
                    amplitude: amplitude * (1 - 0.1 * Double(index)),
                    waves: 1 + 0.5 * Double(index % 2 + 1)
                )
                .fill(colors[index].opacity(0.85))
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
        .task(id: reduceMotion) { updateMotion() }
    }

    private func updateMotion() {
        if reduceMotion {
            withTransaction(\.disablesAnimations, true) { phase = 0 }
        } else {
            withAnimation(.linear(duration: period).repeatForever(autoreverses: false)) {
                phase = 2 * .pi
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct WavesBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink, .purple], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            WavesBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "sun.horizon.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("High Tide")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
            .padding(.top, 150)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    WavesBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Elastic Drag Button

A round button that stretches toward the finger and springs back on release.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ElasticDragButton/ElasticDragButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A round button that stretches toward your finger and springs back on release.
/// A press that does not travel counts as a tap.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button stays in place and only dims while pressed.
struct ElasticDragButton: View {
    let systemImage: String
    let label: String
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    var reach: Double = 80
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var pull = CGSize.zero
    @State private var stretch = 0.0
    @State private var angle = Angle.zero
    @GestureState private var isPressed = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var diameter = 112.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let tapTolerance = 12.0

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle()
                .fill(tint.gradient)
                .scaleEffect(x: 1 + stretch, y: 1 - stretch * 0.45)
                .rotationEffect(angle)
                .shadow(color: tint.opacity(0.45), radius: 18, y: 10)

            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
        .offset(pull)
        .opacity(isPressed && reduceMotion ? 0.7 : 1)
        .contentShape(.circle)
        .gesture(drag)
        .onChange(of: isPressed) { _, pressed in
            guard !pressed else { return }
            withAnimation(.spring(duration: 0.6, bounce: 0.65)) {
                pull = .zero
                stretch = 0
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
        .accessibilityAction { action() }
    }

    private var drag: some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)
            .updating($isPressed) { _, state, _ in state = true }
            .onChanged { value in
                guard !reduceMotion else { return }
                let distance = hypot(value.translation.width, value.translation.height)
                guard distance > 1 else { return }

                let eased = reach * (1 - exp(-distance / (reach * 2)))
                pull = CGSize(
                    width: value.translation.width * eased / distance,
                    height: value.translation.height * eased / distance
                )
                stretch = eased / reach * 0.4
                angle = .radians(atan2(value.translation.height, value.translation.width))
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                if hypot(value.translation.width, value.translation.height) < tapTolerance {
                    action()
                }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ElasticDragButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var taps = 0

    var body: some View {
        ElasticDragButton(systemImage: "hand.point.up.left.fill", label: "Stretch") {
            taps += 1
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text("Pull me")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text(taps == 1 ? "1 tap" : "\(taps) taps")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .pink.opacity(0.12)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        )
    }
}

#Preview {
    ElasticDragButtonDemo()
}
```

## Expanding Search Button

A round magnifying glass button that opens into a search field.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ExpandingSearchButton/ExpandingSearchButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A round magnifying glass button that opens into a search field.
/// Closing it clears the text and dismisses the keyboard.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the field appears without animating.
struct ExpandingSearchButton: View {
    @Binding var text: String
    var prompt: String = "Search"
    var onSubmit: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var height = 54.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.25)
    }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            Button {
                open()
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .frame(width: height, height: height)
                    .contentShape(.circle)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel("Search")

            if isExpanded {
                TextField(prompt, text: $text)
                    .focused($isFocused)
                    .submitLabel(.search)
                    .onSubmit(onSubmit)
                    .onAppear { isFocused = true }
                    .transition(.opacity)

                Button {
                    close()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.title3)
                        .symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)
                        .frame(width: height, height: height)
                        .contentShape(.circle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel("Close")
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: isExpanded ? .infinity : height)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .capsule)
        .overlay(Capsule().strokeBorder(.quaternary))
    }

    private func open() {
        if isExpanded {
            isFocused = true
        } else {
            withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = true }
        }
    }

    private func close() {
        text = ""
        isFocused = false
        withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = false }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ExpandingSearchButtonDemo: View {
    private struct Row: Identifiable {
        let id: String
        let systemImage: String
    }

    @State private var text = ""

    private let rows = [
        Row(id: "Albums", systemImage: "square.stack.fill"),
        Row(id: "Artists", systemImage: "music.mic"),
        Row(id: "Playlists", systemImage: "music.note.list"),
        Row(id: "Podcasts", systemImage: "antenna.radiowaves.left.and.right"),
        Row(id: "Radio", systemImage: "dot.radiowaves.left.and.right"),
    ]

    private var visibleRows: [Row] {
        text.isEmpty ? rows : rows.filter { $0.id.localizedStandardContains(text) }
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 28) {
            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                Text("Library")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                    .fixedSize()
                ExpandingSearchButton(text: $text)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .trailing)
            }

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                ForEach(visibleRows) { row in
                    Label(row.id, systemImage: row.systemImage)
                        .font(.title3)
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
    }
}

#Preview {
    ExpandingSearchButtonDemo()
}
```

## Gradient Border Button

A capsule button whose border is an angular gradient that keeps rotating.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/GradientBorderButton/GradientBorderButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A capsule button whose border is an angular gradient that keeps rotating.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the gradient stays still.
struct GradientBorderButton<Content: View>: View {
    var colors: [Color] = [.pink, .orange, .yellow, .mint, .blue, .purple, .pink]
    var lineWidth: Double = 3
    var period: Double = 3
    let action: () -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let label: () -> Content

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            label()
                .font(.title3.bold())
                .padding(.horizontal, 40)
                .padding(.vertical, 20)
                .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .capsule)
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .overlay {
            TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: nil, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
                border(at: context.date)
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
    }

    private func border(at date: Date) -> some View {
        let elapsed = date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: period)
        let gradient = AngularGradient(
            colors: colors,
            center: .center,
            angle: .degrees(reduceMotion ? 0 : elapsed / period * 360)
        )

        return ZStack {
            Capsule()
                .strokeBorder(gradient, lineWidth: lineWidth)
                .blur(radius: 12)
                .opacity(0.8)
            Capsule()
                .strokeBorder(gradient, lineWidth: lineWidth)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct GradientBorderButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isUpgraded = false

    var body: some View {
        GradientBorderButton {
            isUpgraded.toggle()
        } label: {
            Label(isUpgraded ? "Upgraded" : "Upgrade to Pro", systemImage: "crown.fill")
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.05, blue: 0.1).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    GradientBorderButtonDemo()
}
```

## Hold To Confirm Button

A round button that fires only after a long press fills its progress ring, and cancels if released early.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/HoldToConfirmButton/HoldToConfirmButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A round button that only fires after being held while its ring fills.
/// Releasing early drains the ring and cancels.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ring still fills, because it carries the meaning,
/// but the button does not squeeze. VoiceOver users confirm with a double tap.
struct HoldToConfirmButton: View {
    let title: String
    var systemImage: String = "checkmark"
    var tint: Color = .red
    var holdDuration: Double = 1.2
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var progress = 0.0
    @State private var isConfirmed = false
    @State private var holdTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var diameter = 116.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var ringWidth = 8.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var isHolding: Bool { progress > 0 && !isConfirmed }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .stroke(tint.opacity(0.18), lineWidth: ringWidth)
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: progress)
                    .stroke(isConfirmed ? Color.green : tint, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: ringWidth, lineCap: .round))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
                Circle()
                    .fill((isConfirmed ? Color.green : tint).gradient)
                    .padding(ringWidth * 1.75)
                Image(systemName: isConfirmed ? "checkmark" : systemImage)
                    .font(.title.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .symbolEffect(.replace))
            }
            .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
            .scaleEffect(isHolding && !reduceMotion ? 0.92 : 1)
            .contentShape(.circle)
            // The gesture only reports pressing. The task below times the hold,
            // so the long minimum duration here never completes first.
            .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 60, perform: {}, onPressingChanged: { isPressing in
                pressingChanged(isPressing)
            })

            Text(title)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: isConfirmed) { _, confirmed in confirmed }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityHint("Double tap to confirm")
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
        .accessibilityAction { confirm() }
    }

    private func pressingChanged(_ isPressing: Bool) {
        guard !isConfirmed else { return }
        holdTask?.cancel()

        if isPressing {
            withAnimation(.linear(duration: holdDuration)) { progress = 1 }
            holdTask = Task {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(holdDuration))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                confirm()
            }
        } else {
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) { progress = 0 }
        }
    }

    private func confirm() {
        guard !isConfirmed else { return }
        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2)) {
            progress = 1
            isConfirmed = true
        }
        action()

        holdTask = Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.2))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.3)) {
                progress = 0
                isConfirmed = false
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct HoldToConfirmButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var deleted = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HoldToConfirmButton(title: "Hold to delete", systemImage: "trash.fill") {
            deleted += 1
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(deleted, format: .number)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .numericText(value: Double(deleted)))
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: deleted)
                Text("Files deleted")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
            .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .background(Color(uiColor: .systemGroupedBackground).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    HoldToConfirmButtonDemo()
}
```

## Like Burst Button

A heart button that pops and throws out a burst of small particles when liked.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/LikeBurstButton/LikeBurstButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A heart that pops and throws out a burst of small particles when liked.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the heart simply fills, with no pop or burst.
struct LikeBurstButton: View {
    @Binding var isLiked: Bool
    var color: Color = .pink
    var particleCount: Int = 12

    @State private var burstCount = 0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var heartSize = 72.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            isLiked.toggle()
            if isLiked && !reduceMotion {
                burstCount += 1
            }
        } label: {
            ZStack {
                ForEach(0..<particleCount, id: \.self) { index in
                    LikeBurstButtonSpark(
                        angle: Double(index) / Double(particleCount) * 360,
                        reach: heartSize * (index.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 1.25 : 0.95),
                        size: heartSize * 0.14,
                        color: [color, .orange, .yellow][index % 3],
                        trigger: burstCount
                    )
                }

                Image(systemName: isLiked ? "heart.fill" : "heart")
                    .font(.system(size: heartSize, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(isLiked ? color : Color.secondary)
                    .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: 1.0, trigger: burstCount) { content, scale in
                        content.scaleEffect(scale)
                    } keyframes: { _ in
                        KeyframeTrack {
                            CubicKeyframe(0.6, duration: 0.09)
                            SpringKeyframe(1.3, duration: 0.2, spring: .bouncy)
                            SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.35, spring: .bouncy)
                        }
                    }
            }
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: burstCount)
        .accessibilityLabel("Like")
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isLiked ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

private struct LikeBurstButtonSparkState {
    var distance = 0.0
    var scale = 0.0
    var opacity = 0.0
}

private struct LikeBurstButtonSpark: View {
    let angle: Double
    let reach: Double
    let size: Double
    let color: Color
    let trigger: Int

    var body: some View {
        Circle()
            .fill(color)
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: LikeBurstButtonSparkState(), trigger: trigger) { [angle] content, state in
                content
                    .scaleEffect(state.scale)
                    .opacity(state.opacity)
                    .offset(y: -state.distance)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(angle))
            } keyframes: { _ in
                KeyframeTrack(\.distance) {
                    MoveKeyframe(0)
                    CubicKeyframe(reach, duration: 0.6)
                }
                KeyframeTrack(\.scale) {
                    MoveKeyframe(0.2)
                    SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.18, spring: .bouncy)
                    LinearKeyframe(0.1, duration: 0.42)
                }
                KeyframeTrack(\.opacity) {
                    MoveKeyframe(1)
                    LinearKeyframe(1, duration: 0.35)
                    LinearKeyframe(0, duration: 0.25)
                }
            }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct LikeBurstButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isLiked = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var count: Int { isLiked ? 129 : 128 }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            LikeBurstButton(isLiked: $isLiked)

            VStack(spacing: 4) {
                Text(count, format: .number)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .numericText(value: Double(count)))
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: count)
                Text("people love this")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color.pink.opacity(0.08).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    LikeBurstButtonDemo()
}
```

## Morphing Submit Button

A submit button that morphs into a spinner while it works and then into a checkmark.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/MorphingSubmitButton/MorphingSubmitButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

private enum MorphingSubmitButtonPhase {
    case idle, loading, success
}

/// A submit button that collapses into a spinner while its async action runs,
/// then turns into a checkmark before returning to normal.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button keeps its shape and only its content crossfades.
struct MorphingSubmitButton: View {
    let title: String
    var tint: Color = .blue
    var successColor: Color = .green
    var successDuration: Double = 1.2
    let action: @MainActor () async -> Void

    @State private var phase = MorphingSubmitButtonPhase.idle
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var height = 64.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var morph: Animation {
        reduceMotion ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : .spring(duration: 0.5, bounce: 0.3)
    }

    private var isCollapsed: Bool { phase != .idle && !reduceMotion }

    private var accessibilityTitle: String {
        switch phase {
        case .idle: title
        case .loading: "Submitting"
        case .success: "Done"
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            submit()
        } label: {
            ZStack {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.title3.bold())
                    .fixedSize()
                    .opacity(phase == .idle ? 1 : 0)

                if phase == .loading {
                    ProgressView()
                        .tint(.white)
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }

                if phase == .success {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                        .font(.title2.bold())
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, isCollapsed ? 0 : 52)
            .frame(width: isCollapsed ? height : nil, height: height)
            .background(
                phase == .success ? successColor : tint,
                in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: isCollapsed ? height / 2 : 18, style: .continuous)
            )
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: phase) { _, newPhase in newPhase == .success }
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityTitle)
    }

    private func submit() {
        guard phase == .idle else { return }
        withAnimation(morph) { phase = .loading }

        Task {
            await action()
            withAnimation(morph) { phase = .success }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(successDuration))
            withAnimation(morph) { phase = .idle }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MorphingSubmitButtonDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 32) {
            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "paperplane.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(.blue)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("Join the waitlist")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text("We will write when your spot opens.")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            MorphingSubmitButton(title: "Submit") {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.4))
            }
            .frame(height: 80)
        }
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}
```

## Pressable Button Style

A button style that shrinks and dims on press, then springs back.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/PressableButtonStyle/PressableButtonStyle.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Shrinks and dims a button while it is pressed, then springs back.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button only dims.
struct PressableButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    var pressedScale: CGFloat = 0.94
    var pressedOpacity: Double = 0.8

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed && !reduceMotion ? pressedScale : 1)
            .opacity(configuration.isPressed ? pressedOpacity : 1)
            .animation(.spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.45), value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}

extension ButtonStyle where Self == PressableButtonStyle {
    static var pressable: PressableButtonStyle { PressableButtonStyle() }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PressableButtonStyleDemo: View {
    @State private var likes = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Text(likes == 1 ? "1 like" : "\(likes) likes")
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .contentTransition(.numericText())

            Button {
                withAnimation { likes += 1 }
            } label: {
                Label("Like", systemImage: "heart.fill")
                    .font(.title2.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 44)
                    .padding(.vertical, 20)
                    .background(.pink.gradient, in: .capsule)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.pressable)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

    PressableButtonStyleDemo()
}
```

## Pulse Ring Button

A round button with rings that keep radiating out from behind it.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/PulseRingButton/PulseRingButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

private enum PulseRingButtonPhase {
    case rest, expanded
}

/// A round button with rings that keep radiating out from behind it.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, a single still halo replaces the rings.
struct PulseRingButton: View {
    let systemImage: String
    let label: String
    var tint: Color = .red
    var ringCount: Int = 3
    var ringDuration: Double = 1.6
    var stagger: Double = 0.35
    let action: () -> Void

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var diameter = 104.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Group {
                if reduceMotion {
                    Circle()
                        .fill(tint.opacity(0.2))
                        .scaleEffect(1.35)
                } else {
                    ForEach(0..<ringCount, id: \.self) { index in
                        ring(at: index)
                    }
                }
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Button(action: action) {
                Image(systemName: systemImage)
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
                    .background(tint.gradient, in: .circle)
                    .contentShape(.circle)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
        }
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
    }

    /// Every ring waits before growing and again before resetting, and the two
    /// delays add up to the same total, so all rings keep the same period.
    private func ring(at index: Int) -> some View {
        let startDelay = Double(index) * stagger
        let endDelay = Double(ringCount - 1 - index) * stagger

        return Circle()
            .fill(tint)
            .phaseAnimator([PulseRingButtonPhase.rest, .expanded]) { content, phase in
                content
                    .scaleEffect(phase == .expanded ? 2.5 : 1)
                    .opacity(phase == .expanded ? 0 : 0.55)
            } animation: { phase in
                phase == .expanded
                    ? .easeOut(duration: ringDuration).delay(startDelay)
                    : .linear(duration: 0.01).delay(endDelay)
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PulseRingButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isRecording = true

    var body: some View {
        PulseRingButton(systemImage: isRecording ? "mic.fill" : "mic.slash.fill", label: "Record") {
            isRecording.toggle()
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(isRecording ? "Listening" : "Muted")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text("Tap to toggle the microphone")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.65))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .background(Color(red: 0.1, green: 0.05, blue: 0.08).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    PulseRingButtonDemo()
}
```

## Shimmer Button

A gradient capsule button with a band of light that sweeps across it in a loop.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ShimmerButton/ShimmerButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A gradient capsule button with a band of light that sweeps across it in a loop.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the sweep is removed and the button stays still.
struct ShimmerButton: View {
    let title: String
    var systemImage: String?
    var colors: [Color] = [.indigo, .purple]
    var sweepDuration: Double = 1.1
    var pause: Double = 0.9
    let action: () -> Void

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                if let systemImage {
                    Image(systemName: systemImage)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }
                Text(title)
            }
            .font(.title3.bold())
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, 40)
            .padding(.vertical, 20)
            .background(LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing))
            .overlay {
                if !reduceMotion {
                    sweep
                }
            }
            .clipShape(.capsule)
            .contentShape(.capsule)
            .shadow(color: (colors.first ?? .clear).opacity(0.5), radius: 18, y: 8)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var sweep: some View {
        LinearGradient(colors: [.clear, .white.opacity(0.65), .clear], startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing)
            .scaleEffect(x: 0.4, y: 2.5)
            .rotationEffect(.degrees(20))
            .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: -1.1, repeating: true) { content, position in
                content.visualEffect { effect, proxy in
                    effect.offset(x: position * proxy.size.width)
                }
            } keyframes: { _ in
                KeyframeTrack {
                    LinearKeyframe(1.1, duration: sweepDuration)
                    LinearKeyframe(1.1, duration: pause)
                }
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ShimmerButtonDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 36) {
            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Text("Unlock everything")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text("Every feature, free for a week.")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
            }

            ShimmerButton(title: "Start free trial", systemImage: "sparkles") {}
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(red: 0.07, green: 0.06, blue: 0.16).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

    ShimmerButtonDemo()
}
```

## Avatar Stack

Overlapping avatars of initials with a badge counting the rest.

Category: Cards. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Cards/AvatarStack/AvatarStack.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

enum AvatarStackMath {
    /// Splits a number of people into the avatars to draw and the count for the badge.
    static func visibleAndOverflow(count: Int, maxVisible: Int) -> (visible: Int, overflow: Int) {
        let visible = min(max(count, 0), max(maxVisible, 0))
        return (visible, max(count, 0) - visible)
    }

    /// The first letters of the first and last words of a name.
    static func initials(of name: String) -> String {
        let words = name.split(whereSeparator: \.isWhitespace)
        guard let first = words.first?.first else { return "?" }
        guard words.count > 1, let last = words.last?.first else { return String(first).uppercased() }
        return "\(first)\(last)".uppercased()
    }
}

/// Overlapping avatars of initials, with a +N badge for everyone who does not fit.
struct AvatarStack: View {
    let names: [String]
    var maxVisible = 4
    var diameter: CGFloat = 48

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var textScale = 1.0

    private var size: CGFloat { diameter * textScale }

    private static var palette: [Color] { [.indigo, .pink, .orange, .teal, .purple, .blue] }

    private var split: (visible: Int, overflow: Int) {
        AvatarStackMath.visibleAndOverflow(count: names.count, maxVisible: maxVisible)
    }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: -size * 0.28) {
            ForEach(Array(names.prefix(split.visible).enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, name in
                circle(AvatarStackMath.initials(of: name), fill: color(for: name))
                    .zIndex(Double(-index))
                    .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
            }

            if split.overflow > 0 {
                circle("+\(split.overflow)", fill: .gray)
                    .contentTransition(.numericText())
                    .zIndex(Double(-split.visible))
                    .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(names.isEmpty ? "No people" : names.formatted(.list(type: .and)))
    }

    private func circle(_ text: String, fill: Color) -> some View {
        Text(text)
            .font(.system(.title3, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
            .lineLimit(1)
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .background(fill.gradient, in: .circle)
            .overlay { Circle().strokeBorder(.background, lineWidth: 3) }
    }

    private func color(for name: String) -> Color {
        let total = name.unicodeScalars.reduce(0) { $0 + Int($1.value) }
        return Self.palette[total % Self.palette.count]
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AvatarStackDemo: View {
    private let everyone = ["Ana Ruiz", "Luis Vega", "Marta Gil", "Omar Haddad", "Nora Lind", "Pablo Sanz", "Yuki Mori", "Sara Blanco", "Tomás Rey"]

    @State private var count = 3
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
                Text("Design review")
                    .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text("Today at 16:30")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                AvatarStack(names: Array(everyone.prefix(count)), diameter: 64)
                    .padding(.top, 8)
            }
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.12), radius: 18, y: 10)

            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                Button("Remove", systemImage: "person.badge.minus") { change(by: -1) }
                    .disabled(count == 0)
                Button("Add", systemImage: "person.badge.plus") { change(by: 1) }
                    .disabled(count == everyone.count)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.purple.opacity(0.4), .orange.opacity(0.3)], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing))
    }

    private func change(by amount: Int) {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.4)) { count += amount }
    }
}

#Preview {
    AvatarStackDemo()
}
```

## Expandable Info Card

A card that expands to show more, with a chevron that turns.

Category: Cards. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Cards/ExpandableInfoCard/ExpandableInfoCard.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A card that expands to show more, with a chevron that turns.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the details fade in place.
struct ExpandableInfoCard<Details: View>: View {
    let title: String
    var subtitle: String?
    var systemImage = "info.circle.fill"
    var tint: Color = .blue
    @ViewBuilder var details: () -> Details

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var iconSize = 40.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            Button {
                withAnimation(reduceMotion ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.2)) {
                    isExpanded.toggle()
                }
            } label: {
                header
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel(title)
            .accessibilityValue(isExpanded ? "Expanded" : "Collapsed")
            .accessibilityHint(subtitle ?? "")

            if isExpanded {
                details()
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .padding([.horizontal, .bottom], 16)
                    .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .opacity.combined(with: .move(edge: .top)))
            }
        }
        .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 22))
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.08), radius: 12, y: 6)
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 14) {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.title3)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)
                .background(tint.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 12))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.headline)
                if let subtitle {
                    Text(subtitle)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 8)

            Image(systemName: "chevron.down")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(isExpanded ? 180 : 0))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .contentShape(.rect)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo
```
