## Glass Button Gallery

A reference gallery of the glass and prominent glass button styles in several sizes, shapes and tints.

Category: Glass. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Glass/GlassButtonGallery/GlassButtonGallery.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A tidy reference sheet of the system Liquid Glass button styles.
///
/// The styles draw their own press response, which the system adapts to Reduce Motion.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassButtonGallery: View {
    var tints: [(name: String, color: Color)] = [
        ("Blue", .blue), ("Pink", .pink), ("Orange", .orange), ("Green", .green),
    ]
    var onPress: (String) -> Void = { _ in }

    private let sizes: [(name: String, size: ControlSize)] = [
        ("Mini", .mini), ("Small", .small), ("Regular", .regular), ("Large", .large), ("Extra Large", .extraLarge),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
            section("Sizes") {
                Grid(horizontalSpacing: 16, verticalSpacing: 10) {
                    ForEach(sizes, id: \.name) { item in
                        GridRow {
                            glassButton(item.name, label: "\(item.name) glass").controlSize(item.size)
                            prominentButton(item.name, label: "\(item.name) prominent").controlSize(item.size)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }

            section("Shapes") {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    glassButton("Capsule", label: "Capsule").buttonBorderShape(.capsule)
                    prominentButton("Rounded", label: "Rounded").buttonBorderShape(.roundedRectangle(radius: 10))
                    iconButton("star.fill", label: "Circle", prominent: false)
                    iconButton("heart.fill", label: "Filled circle", prominent: true)
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }

            section("Tints") {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(tints, id: \.name) { tint in
                        iconButton("drop.fill", label: "\(tint.name) glass", prominent: false).tint(tint.color)
                        iconButton("drop.fill", label: "\(tint.name) prominent", prominent: true).tint(tint.color)
                    }
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
        }
    }

    private func section(_ title: String, @ViewBuilder content: () -> some View) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.headline)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)

            content()
        }
    }

    private func glassButton(_ title: String, label: String) -> some View {
        Button(title) { onPress(label) }
            .buttonStyle(.glass)
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    private func prominentButton(_ title: String, label: String) -> some View {
        Button(title) { onPress(label) }
            .buttonStyle(.glassProminent)
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func iconButton(_ systemImage: String, label: String, prominent: Bool) -> some View {
        let button = Button(label, systemImage: systemImage) { onPress(label) }
            .labelStyle(.iconOnly)
            .buttonBorderShape(.circle)

        if prominent {
            button.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)
        } else {
            button.buttonStyle(.glass)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassButtonGalleryDemo: View {
    @State private var lastPressed = "Tap any button"

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.mint, .cyan, .indigo], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
                    Text(lastPressed)
                        .font(.title.bold())
                        .contentTransition(.opacity)
                        .animation(.easeInOut, value: lastPressed)

                    GlassButtonGallery { lastPressed = $0 }
                }
                .padding(24)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
#Preview {
    GlassButtonGalleryDemo()
}
```

## Glass Segmented Control

A segmented control with a Liquid Glass thumb that slides between segments.

Category: Glass. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Glass/GlassSegmentedControl/GlassSegmentedControl.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A segmented control with a Liquid Glass thumb that slides between segments.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the thumb jumps to the new segment.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassSegmentedControl<Segment: Hashable>: View {
    let segments: [Segment]
    @Binding var selection: Segment
    var tint: Color?
    let title: (Segment) -> String

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var height = 44.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(segments, id: \.self) { segment in
                button(for: segment)
            }
        }
        .background { thumb }
        .padding(4)
        .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .capsule)
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selection)
    }

    /// One view that moves, drawn behind the labels so they stay readable on top of it.
    private var thumb: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            let width = proxy.size.width / CGFloat(max(segments.count, 1))
            let index = segments.firstIndex(of: selection) ?? 0

            Color.clear
                .frame(width: width)
                .glassEffect(.regular.tint(tint), in: .capsule)
                .offset(x: width * CGFloat(index))
        }
    }

    private func button(for segment: Segment) -> some View {
        let isSelected = segment == selection

        return Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.4)) {
                selection = segment
            }
        } label: {
            Text(title(segment))
                .font(.subheadline.weight(isSelected ? .semibold : .medium))
                .lineLimit(1)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: height)
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassSegmentedControlDemo: View {
    @State private var period = "Week"
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let steps = ["Day": 8_214, "Week": 61_730, "Month": 248_902, "Year": 2_904_117]

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.teal, .blue, .indigo], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 28) {
                VStack(spacing: 4) {
                    Text("Steps walked")
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))

                    Text(steps[period, default: 0], format: .number)
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                        .contentTransition(.numericText())
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: period)
                }

                GlassSegmentedControl(segments: ["Day", "Week", "Month", "Year"], selection: $period) { $0 }
                    .padding(.horizontal, 24)
            }
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
#Preview {
    GlassSegmentedControlDemo()
}
```

## Glass Tab Accessory

A tab view with a Liquid Glass accessory above a tab bar that minimizes on scroll.

Category: Glass. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Glass/GlassTabAccessory/GlassTabAccessory.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A tab view with a Liquid Glass accessory above a tab bar that minimizes on scroll.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the tab bar stays at its full size.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassTabAccessory<Selection: Hashable, Tabs: TabContent<Selection>, Accessory: View>: View {
    @Binding var selection: Selection
    var minimizeBehavior: TabBarMinimizeBehavior = .onScrollDown
    @TabContentBuilder<Selection> let tabs: () -> Tabs
    @ViewBuilder let accessory: () -> Accessory

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TabView(selection: $selection, content: tabs)
            .tabBarMinimizeBehavior(reduceMotion ? .never : minimizeBehavior)
            .tabViewBottomAccessory(content: accessory)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
private struct GlassTabAccessoryPlayer: View {
    @Binding var isPlaying: Bool

    @Environment(\.tabViewBottomAccessoryPlacement) private var placement
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: "waveform")
                .symbolEffect(.variableColor.iterative, isActive: isPlaying && !reduceMotion)
                .foregroundStyle(.pink)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
                Text("Midnight Drive")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                    .lineLimit(1)

                if placement != .inline {
                    Text("The Glass Hours")
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .lineLimit(1)
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            Button(isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play", systemImage: isPlaying ? "pause.fill" : "play.fill") {
                isPlaying.toggle()
            }
            .labelStyle(.iconOnly)
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassTabAccessoryDemo: View {
    @State private var selection = "albums"
    @State private var isPlaying = true

    var body: some View {
        GlassTabAccessory(selection: $selection) {
            Tab("Albums", systemImage: "square.stack.fill", value: "albums") {
                shelf(title: "New music", colors: [.pink, .orange, .purple, .blue, .teal])
            }
            Tab("Radio", systemImage: "dot.radiowaves.left.and.right", value: "radio") {
                shelf(title: "On air", colors: [.indigo, .mint, .red, .cyan, .yellow])
            }
        } accessory: {
            GlassTabAccessoryPlayer(isPlaying: $isPlaying)
        }
    }

    private func shelf(title: String, colors: [Color]) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 150), spacing: 14)], spacing: 14) {
                ForEach(0..<24, id: \.self) { index in
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20)
                        .fill(colors[index % colors.count].gradient)
                        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .top, spacing: 0) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.bottom, 6)
                .background(.bar)
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)

}
```

## Glass Tag Cloud

Tags of tinted, interactive Liquid Glass that melt together when they get close.

Category: Glass. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Glass/GlassTagCloud/GlassTagCloud.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassTagCloudTag: Identifiable {
    let title: String
    let tint: Color

    var id: String { title }
}

/// Tags of tinted, interactive Liquid Glass that melt together when they get close.
///
/// `mergeDistance` is the gap below which neighbouring tags blend. With Reduce Motion on,
/// selecting a tag changes it without animating.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassTagCloud: View {
    let tags: [GlassTagCloudTag]
    @Binding var selection: Set<String>
    var spacing: CGFloat = 16
    var mergeDistance: CGFloat = 10

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var horizontalPadding = 16.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var verticalPadding = 10.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        GlassEffectContainer(spacing: mergeDistance) {
            GlassTagCloudLayout(spacing: spacing) {
                ForEach(tags) { tag in
                    tagButton(tag)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func tagButton(_ tag: GlassTagCloudTag) -> some View {
        let isSelected = selection.contains(tag.title)

        return Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy) {
                if isSelected {
                    selection.remove(tag.title)
                } else {
                    selection.insert(tag.title)
                }
            }
        } label: {
            Text(tag.title)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, horizontalPadding)
                .padding(.vertical, verticalPadding)
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
        .glassEffect(.regular.tint(tag.tint.opacity(isSelected ? 0.85 : 0.3)).interactive(), in: .capsule)
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
private struct GlassTagCloudLayout: Layout {
    var spacing: CGFloat

    var animatableData: CGFloat {
        get { spacing }
        set { spacing = newValue }
    }

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let sizes = subviews.map { $0.sizeThatFits(ProposedViewSize(width: proposal.width, height: nil)) }
        return GlassTagCloudFlow.arrange(sizes, width: proposal.width ?? .infinity, spacing: spacing).size
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let tagProposal = ProposedViewSize(width: bounds.width, height: nil)
        let sizes = subviews.map { $0.sizeThatFits(tagProposal) }
        let origins = GlassTagCloudFlow.arrange(sizes, width: bounds.width, spacing: spacing).origins
        for (subview, origin) in zip(subviews, origins) {
            subview.place(at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + origin.x, y: bounds.minY + origin.y), proposal: tagProposal)
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
enum GlassTagCloudFlow {
    /// Places items left to right, starting a new row when the next item would not fit in `width`.
    static func arrange(_ sizes: [CGSize], width: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat) -> (origins: [CGPoint], size: CGSize) {
        var origins: [CGPoint] = []
        var cursor = CGPoint.zero
        var rowHeight: CGFloat = 0
        var usedWidth: CGFloat = 0

        for size in sizes {
            if cursor.x > 0, cursor.x + size.width > width {
                cursor = CGPoint(x: 0, y: cursor.y + rowHeight + spacing)
                rowHeight = 0
            }
            origins.append(cursor)
            usedWidth = max(usedWidth, cursor.x + size.width)
            rowHeight = max(rowHeight, size.height)
            cursor.x += size.width + spacing
        }

        return (origins, CGSize(width: usedWidth, height: cursor.y + rowHeight))
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassTagCloudDemo: View {
    @State private var selection: Set<String> = ["SwiftUI"]
    @State private var isTight = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let tags = [
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "SwiftUI", tint: .blue),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Animation", tint: .pink),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Layout", tint: .orange),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Glass", tint: .teal),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Gestures", tint: .purple),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Symbols", tint: .green),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Charts", tint: .red),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Navigation", tint: .indigo),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Metal", tint: .mint),
        GlassTagCloudTag(title: "Widgets", tint: .yellow),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .black], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            // Scrolls only when Dynamic Type makes the content taller than the screen.
            ViewThatFits(in: .vertical) {
                content

                ScrollView {
                    content
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var content: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 32) {
            Text("Pick your interests")
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .foregroundStyle(.white)

            GlassTagCloud(tags: tags, selection: $selection, spacing: isTight ? 3 : 18)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)

            Toggle("Tight spacing", isOn: $isTight.animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.7)))
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .padding(24)
    }
```

## Glass Tool Strip

A row of Liquid Glass tool buttons with related tools fused into one shape.

Category: Glass. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Glass/GlassToolStrip/GlassToolStrip.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassToolStripTool: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let systemImage: String
    /// Tools with the same group share one piece of glass. Nil keeps the tool on its own.
    var group: String?
}

/// A row of Liquid Glass tool buttons, with related tools fused into one shape.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, tools change without animating.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassToolStrip: View {
    let tools: [GlassToolStripTool]
    @Binding var selection: String?
    var isGrouped = true
    var tint: Color = .accentColor

    @Namespace private var namespace
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title3) private var buttonSize = 52.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // Scrolls only when Dynamic Type makes the row wider than the space it has.
        ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            strip

            ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
                strip
            }
            .scrollClipDisabled()
        }
    }

    private var strip: some View {
        GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 10) {
            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                ForEach(tools) { tool in
                    toolButton(tool)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func toolButton(_ tool: GlassToolStripTool) -> some View {
        let isSelected = tool.id == selection

        return Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy) {
                selection = isSelected ? nil : tool.id
            }
        } label: {
            Image(systemName: tool.systemImage)
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? tint : .primary)
                .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(tool.title)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
        // A union shares one shape across its members, so it has to be a capsule, and
        // selection only tints the symbol. A square capsule draws as a circle on its own.
        .glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)
        .glassEffectUnion(id: isGrouped ? tool.group : nil, namespace: namespace)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct GlassToolStripDemo: View {
    @State private var selection: String? = "pen"
    @State private var isGrouped = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let tools = [
        GlassToolStripTool(id: "pen", title: "Pen", systemImage: "pencil.tip", group: "draw"),
        GlassToolStripTool(id: "marker", title: "Marker", systemImage: "highlighter", group: "draw"),
        GlassToolStripTool(id: "eraser", title: "Eraser", systemImage: "eraser", group: "draw"),
        GlassToolStripTool(id: "undo", title: "Undo", systemImage: "arrow.uturn.backward", group: "history"),
        GlassToolStripTool(id: "redo", title: "Redo", systemImage: "arrow.uturn.forward", group: "history"),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            MeshGradient(
                width: 2,
                height: 2,
                points: [[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1]],
                colors: [.pink, .orange, .purple, .blue]
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 32) {
                GlassToolStrip(tools: tools, selection: $selection, isGrouped: isGrouped, tint: .indigo)

                Button("Group tools", systemImage: isGrouped ? "square.split.2x1" : "square.on.square") {
                    withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.5)) { isGrouped.toggle() }
                }
                .buttonStyle(.glass)
                .accessibilityValue(isGrouped ? "On" : "Off")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Color Swatch Picker

A grid of selectable color swatches where the chosen one grows a ring.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/ColorSwatchPicker/ColorSwatchPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

struct ColorSwatchPickerOption: Hashable, Identifiable {
    let name: String
    let color: Color

    var id: String { name }
}

/// A grid of color swatches where the selected one grows a ring.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ring fades in without growing.
struct ColorSwatchPicker: View {
    let options: [ColorSwatchPickerOption]
    @Binding var selection: ColorSwatchPickerOption

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var swatchSize = 48.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: swatchSize), spacing: 12)], spacing: 12) {
            ForEach(options) { option in
                swatch(option)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? .easeOut(duration: 0.15) : .spring(duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.5), value: selection)
    }

    private func swatch(_ option: ColorSwatchPickerOption) -> some View {
        let isSelected = option == selection

        return Button {
            selection = option
        } label: {
            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .strokeBorder(option.color, lineWidth: 3)
                    .scaleEffect(isSelected || reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.5)
                    .opacity(isSelected ? 1 : 0)

                Circle()
                    .fill(option.color.gradient)
                    .padding(isSelected ? 8 : 4)
            }
            .frame(width: swatchSize, height: swatchSize)
            .contentShape(.circle)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(option.name)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ColorSwatchPickerDemo: View {
    private static let options = [
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Coral", color: .red),
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Amber", color: .orange),
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Mint", color: .mint),
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Sky", color: .cyan),
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Indigo", color: .indigo),
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Rose", color: .pink),
    ]

    @State private var selection = options[2]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 32) {
            Image(systemName: "paintpalette.fill")
                .font(.largeTitle)
                .imageScale(.large)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .frame(height: 220)
                .background(selection.color.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))
                .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: selection)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text("Pick an accent")
                .font(.title2.bold())

            ColorSwatchPicker(options: Self.options, selection: $selection)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}
```

## Floating Label Text Field

A text field whose placeholder floats up when it gains focus or has text.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/FloatingLabelTextField/FloatingLabelTextField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A text field whose placeholder floats up on focus or once it has text.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the label changes place without sliding.
struct FloatingLabelTextField: View {
    let title: String
    @Binding var text: String
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var fieldHeight = 60.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var textDrop = 9.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var labelLift = 12.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var isFloating: Bool { isFocused || !text.isEmpty }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.body)
                .foregroundStyle(isFocused ? tint : Color.secondary)
                .scaleEffect(isFloating ? 0.78 : 1, anchor: .leading)
                .offset(y: isFloating ? -labelLift : 0)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
                .allowsHitTesting(false)

            TextField(title, text: $text, prompt: Text(verbatim: ""))
                .font(.body)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .tint(tint)
                .offset(y: isFloating ? textDrop : 0)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .frame(minHeight: fieldHeight)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14))
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)
                .strokeBorder(isFocused ? tint : Color.secondary.opacity(0.25), lineWidth: isFocused ? 2 : 1)
        }
        .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 14))
        .onTapGesture { isFocused = true }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.2), value: isFloating)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: isFocused)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

    @State private var name = ""
    @State private var email = ""
    @State private var city = "Valencia"

                .ignoresSafeArea()

                    .font(.title.bold())
                    .padding(.bottom, 8)

                FloatingLabelTextField(title: "Name", text: $name)
                FloatingLabelTextField(title: "Email", text: $email)
                FloatingLabelTextField(title: "City", text: $city)
            }
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.keyboard)
    }
}
```

## OTP Code Field

A one-time code field with one box per digit, backed by a single hidden text field.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/OTPCodeField/OTPCodeField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

enum OTPCodeFieldInput {
    /// Keeps only ASCII digits, up to `length`. Handles pasted text such as "123-456".
    static func sanitized(_ input: String, length: Int) -> String {
        String(input.filter { $0.isASCII && $0.isNumber }.prefix(max(length, 0)))
    }
}

/// A one-time code entry with a box per digit, backed by a single invisible `TextField`.
///
/// The field stays behind the boxes rather than hidden, so VoiceOver, paste and code
/// autofill reach it. With Reduce Motion on, digits appear without a pop.
struct OTPCodeField: View {
    @Binding var code: String
    var length: Int = 6
    var title: String = "Verification code"
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    var onComplete: ((String) -> Void)? = nil

    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var boxHeight = 58.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(0..<length, id: \.self) { index in
                digitBox(at: index)
            }
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
        .background {
            TextField(title, text: $code)
                .textContentType(.oneTimeCode)
                .keyboardType(.numberPad)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .foregroundStyle(.clear)
                .tint(.clear)
        }
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .onTapGesture { isFocused = true }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.5), value: code)
        .onChange(of: code) { oldValue, newValue in
            let clean = OTPCodeFieldInput.sanitized(newValue, length: length)
            if clean != newValue { code = clean }
            if clean.count == length, clean != OTPCodeFieldInput.sanitized(oldValue, length: length) {
                onComplete?(clean)
            }
        }
    }

    private func digitBox(at index: Int) -> some View {
        let digits = Array(code)
        let digit = index < digits.count ? String(digits[index]) : nil
        let isActive = isFocused && index == digits.count

        return RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)
            .fill(.regularMaterial)
            .strokeBorder(isActive ? tint : Color.secondary.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: isActive ? 2 : 1)
            .frame(height: boxHeight)
            .overlay {
                if let digit {
                    Text(digit)
                        .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .semibold))
                        .monospacedDigit()
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .scale(scale: 0.4).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct OTPCodeFieldDemo: View {
    @State private var code = ""
    @State private var isVerified = false

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.3), .cyan.opacity(0.2)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                Image(systemName: isVerified ? "checkmark.shield.fill" : "lock.shield.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .imageScale(.large)
                    .foregroundStyle(isVerified ? Color.green : Color.indigo)
                    .contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(isVerified ? "You are in" : "Check your messages")
                    .font(.title2.bold())

                OTPCodeField(code: $code, title: "Code") { _ in
                    withAnimation { isVerified = true }
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.keyboard)
        .onChange(of: code) { _, newValue in
            if newValue.count < 6 { isVerified = false }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    OTPCodeFieldDemo()
}
```

## Bento Grid Layout

A custom Layout that packs tiles of varied spans into a bento grid.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/BentoGridLayout/BentoGridLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

struct BentoGridLayoutSpan: Equatable, Sendable {
    var columns = 1
    var rows = 1
}

enum BentoGridLayoutMath {
    /// Packs each tile, in order, into the first free slot, reading the grid top to bottom and left to right.
    static func frames(
        spans: [BentoGridLayoutSpan],
        columns: Int,
        width: CGFloat,
        rowHeight: CGFloat,
        spacing: CGFloat
    ) -> [CGRect] {
        guard columns > 0 else { return [] }
        let columnWidth = (width - spacing * CGFloat(columns - 1)) / CGFloat(columns)
        var taken = Set<SIMD2<Int>>()

        func cells(column: Int, row: Int, span: BentoGridLayoutSpan) -> [SIMD2<Int>] {
            (column..<column + span.columns).flatMap { x in
                (row..<row + span.rows).map { y in SIMD2(x, y) }
            }
        }

        func firstFreeSlot(for span: BentoGridLayoutSpan) -> (column: Int, row: Int) {
            var row = 0
            while true {
                for column in 0...(columns - span.columns) where taken.isDisjoint(with: cells(column: column, row: row, span: span)) {
                    return (column, row)
                }
                row += 1
            }
        }

        return spans.map { requested in
            let span = BentoGridLayoutSpan(columns: min(max(requested.columns, 1), columns), rows: max(requested.rows, 1))
            let slot = firstFreeSlot(for: span)
            taken.formUnion(cells(column: slot.column, row: slot.row, span: span))
            return CGRect(
                x: CGFloat(slot.column) * (columnWidth + spacing),
                y: CGFloat(slot.row) * (rowHeight + spacing),
                width: CGFloat(span.columns) * columnWidth + CGFloat(span.columns - 1) * spacing,
                height: CGFloat(span.rows) * rowHeight + CGFloat(span.rows - 1) * spacing
            )
        }
    }
}

private struct BentoGridLayoutSpanKey: LayoutValueKey {
    static let defaultValue = BentoGridLayoutSpan()
}

extension View {
    /// How many columns and rows this tile takes inside a `BentoGridLayout`.
    func bentoGridSpan(columns: Int = 1, rows: Int = 1) -> some View {
        layoutValue(key: BentoGridLayoutSpanKey.self, value: BentoGridLayoutSpan(columns: columns, rows: rows))
    }
}

/// A grid that packs tiles of varied spans, leaving as few holes as it can.
struct BentoGridLayout: Layout {
    var columns = 4
    var rowHeight: CGFloat = 110
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let width = proposal.width ?? CGFloat(columns) * (rowHeight + spacing) - spacing
        let height = frames(for: subviews, width: width).map(\.maxY).max() ?? 0
        return CGSize(width: width, height: height)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        for (subview, frame) in zip(subviews, frames(for: subviews, width: bounds.width)) {
            subview.place(
                at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + frame.minX, y: bounds.minY + frame.minY),
                proposal: ProposedViewSize(frame.size)
            )
        }
    }

    private func frames(for subviews: Subviews, width: CGFloat) -> [CGRect] {
        BentoGridLayoutMath.frames(
            spans: subviews.map { $0[BentoGridLayoutSpanKey.self] },
            columns: columns,
            width: width,
            rowHeight: rowHeight,
            spacing: spacing
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct DemoTile: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let symbol: String
    let colors: [Color]
}

struct BentoGridLayoutDemo: View {
    private let tiles = [
        DemoTile(id: "Sleep", symbol: "moon.fill", colors: [.indigo, .purple]),
        DemoTile(id: "Steps", symbol: "figure.walk", colors: [.green, .teal]),
        DemoTile(id: "Heart", symbol: "heart.fill", colors: [.pink, .red]),
        DemoTile(id: "Water", symbol: "drop.fill", colors: [.cyan, .blue]),
        DemoTile(id: "Sun", symbol: "sun.max.fill", colors: [.yellow, .orange]),
        DemoTile(id: "Focus", symbol: "brain.head.profile", colors: [.purple, .pink]),
        DemoTile(id: "Rest", symbol: "bed.double.fill", colors: [.teal, .indigo]),
    ]

    private let arrangements: [[(columns: Int, rows: Int)]] = [
        [(2, 2), (2, 1), (1, 1), (1, 1), (4, 1), (2, 2), (2, 2)],
        [(4, 1), (1, 2), (3, 2), (2, 1), (2, 1), (2, 1), (2, 1)],
        [(1, 2), (3, 1), (2, 1), (1, 1), (2, 2), (2, 1), (2, 1)],
    ]

    @State private var arrangement = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Text("Today")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)

            BentoGridLayout(rowHeight: 104) {
                ForEach(Array(tiles.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, tile in
                    let span = arrangements[arrangement][index]
                    tileView(tile)
                        .bentoGridSpan(columns: span.columns, rows: span.rows)
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            Button("Shuffle", systemImage: "shuffle") {
                withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.55)) {
                    arrangement = (arrangement + 1) % arrangements.count
                }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.1), .pink.opacity(0.08)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private func tileView(_ tile: DemoTile) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading) {
            Image(systemName: tile.symbol)
                .font(.title2)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
            Text(tile.id)
                .font(.system(.headline, design: .rounded))
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(12)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: tile.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }
}

#Preview {
    BentoGridLayoutDemo()
}
```

## Flow Tags Layout

A custom Layout that wraps tags onto as many lines as they need.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/FlowTagsLayout/FlowTagsLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

enum FlowTagsLayoutMath {
    /// Groups widths into lines. A tag wider than `maxWidth` gets a line of its own.
    static func lines(widths: [CGFloat], maxWidth: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat) -> [Range<Int>] {
        var lines: [Range<Int>] = []
        var start = 0
        var used: CGFloat = 0

        for (index, width) in widths.enumerated() {
            if index == start {
                used = width
            } else if used + spacing + width > maxWidth {
                lines.append(start..<index)
                start = index
                used = width
            } else {
                used += spacing + width
            }
        }

        if start < widths.count {
            lines.append(start..<widths.count)
        }
        return lines
    }
}

/// A layout that wraps its views onto as many lines as they need.
struct FlowTagsLayout: Layout {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 8
    var lineSpacing: CGFloat = 8

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let sizes = measuredSizes(of: subviews, maxWidth: proposal.width ?? .infinity)
        let lines = FlowTagsLayoutMath.lines(widths: sizes.map(\.width), maxWidth: proposal.width ?? .infinity, spacing: spacing)
        let widest = lines.map { lineWidth($0, sizes: sizes) }.max() ?? 0
        let height = lines.reduce(0) { $0 + lineHeight($1, sizes: sizes) } + CGFloat(max(lines.count - 1, 0)) * lineSpacing
        return CGSize(width: proposal.width ?? widest, height: height)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let sizes = measuredSizes(of: subviews, maxWidth: bounds.width)
        var y = bounds.minY

        for line in FlowTagsLayoutMath.lines(widths: sizes.map(\.width), maxWidth: bounds.width, spacing: spacing) {
            let height = lineHeight(line, sizes: sizes)
            var x = bounds.minX

            for index in line {
                subviews[index].place(
                    at: CGPoint(x: x, y: y + height / 2),
                    anchor: .leading,
                    proposal: ProposedViewSize(width: min(sizes[index].width, bounds.width), height: nil)
                )
                x += sizes[index].width + spacing
            }
            y += height + lineSpacing
        }
    }

    /// A view wider than the layout is measured at the width it gets, so its wrapped height counts.
    private func measuredSizes(of subviews: Subviews, maxWidth: CGFloat) -> [CGSize] {
        subviews.map { subview in
            let ideal = subview.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            return ideal.width > maxWidth ? subview.sizeThatFits(ProposedViewSize(width: maxWidth, height: nil)) : ideal
        }
    }

    private func lineWidth(_ line: Range<Int>, sizes: [CGSize]) -> CGFloat {
        sizes[line].reduce(0) { $0 + $1.width } + CGFloat(line.count - 1) * spacing
    }

    private func lineHeight(_ line: Range<Int>, sizes: [CGSize]) -> CGFloat {
        sizes[line].map(\.height).max() ?? 0
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct FlowTagsLayoutDemo: View {
    private static let extras = ["Typography", "Motion", "Haptics", "Color", "Icons"]

    @State private var tags = ["Swift", "Design", "Photography", "Travel", "Coffee", "Running", "Music", "Architecture", "Film", "Cooking", "Books", "Cycling"]
    @State private var added = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.4) }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
            Text("Your interests")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

            FlowTagsLayout(spacing: 10, lineSpacing: 12) {
                ForEach(tags, id: \.self) { tag in
                    Text(tag)
                        .font(.system(.body, design: .rounded, weight: .medium))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 10)
                        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .pink], startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing), in: .capsule)
                        .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                Button("Remove", systemImage: "minus") {
                    withAnimation(animation) {
                        tags.removeFirst()
                        added = max(added - 1, 0)
                    }
                }
                .disabled(tags.isEmpty)

                Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") {
                    withAnimation(animation) {
                        tags.insert(Self.extras[added], at: 0)
                        added += 1
                    }
                }
                .disabled(added == Self.extras.count)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .pink.opacity(0.14)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}
```

## Radial Layout

A custom Layout that spreads views around a circle and animates as the count changes.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/RadialLayout/RadialLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

enum RadialLayoutMath {
    /// Evenly spaced angles, the first one at `start`.
    static func angles(count: Int, start: Angle = .degrees(-90)) -> [Angle] {
        guard count > 0 else { return [] }
        let step = 360.0 / Double(count)
        return (0..<count).map { .degrees(start.degrees + Double($0) * step) }
    }

    static func point(at angle: Angle, center: CGPoint, radius: CGFloat) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(
            x: center.x + radius * cos(angle.radians),
            y: center.y + radius * sin(angle.radians)
        )
    }
}

/// A layout that spreads its views around a circle.
///
/// Change the number of views inside `withAnimation` and the others glide to their new places.
/// Leave `radius` as `nil` to fill the space it is given.
struct RadialLayout: Layout {
    var radius: CGFloat?
    var startAngle: Angle = .degrees(-90)

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        if let radius {
            let side = 2 * radius + largestSide(of: subviews)
            return CGSize(width: side, height: side)
        }
        let size = proposal.replacingUnspecifiedDimensions(by: CGSize(width: 280, height: 280))
        let side = min(size.width, size.height)
        return CGSize(width: side, height: side)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let center = CGPoint(x: bounds.midX, y: bounds.midY)
        let circleRadius = radius ?? max(min(bounds.width, bounds.height) / 2 - largestSide(of: subviews) / 2, 0)

        for (subview, angle) in zip(subviews, RadialLayoutMath.angles(count: subviews.count, start: startAngle)) {
            subview.place(
                at: RadialLayoutMath.point(at: angle, center: center, radius: circleRadius),
                anchor: .center,
                proposal: .unspecified
            )
        }
    }

    private func largestSide(of subviews: Subviews) -> CGFloat {
        subviews.map {
            let size = $0.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            return max(size.width, size.height)
        }.max() ?? 0
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct DemoApp: Identifiable {
    var id: String { name }
    let name: String
    let symbol: String
    let color: Color
}

struct RadialLayoutDemo: View {
    private static let all = [
        DemoApp(name: "Music", symbol: "music.note", color: .pink),
        DemoApp(name: "Photos", symbol: "photo.fill", color: .orange),
        DemoApp(name: "Maps", symbol: "map.fill", color: .green),
        DemoApp(name: "Mail", symbol: "envelope.fill", color: .blue),
        DemoApp(name: "Notes", symbol: "note.text", color: .yellow),
        DemoApp(name: "Weather", symbol: "cloud.sun.fill", color: .cyan),
        DemoApp(name: "Health", symbol: "heart.fill", color: .red),
        DemoApp(name: "Clock", symbol: "clock.fill", color: .purple),
        DemoApp(name: "Camera", symbol: "camera.fill", color: .teal),
    ]

    @State private var count = 5
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var iconSize = 64.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 40) {
            ZStack {
                RadialLayout {
                    ForEach(Self.all.prefix(count)) { app in
                        Image(systemName: app.symbol)
                            .font(.title2)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)
                            .background(app.color.gradient, in: .circle)
                            .accessibilityLabel(app.name)
                            .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                    }
                }

                Text("\(count)")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .contentTransition(.numericText(value: Double(count)))
                    .accessibilityLabel("\(count) apps")
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: 340, maxHeight: 340)

            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                Button("Remove", systemImage: "minus") { change(by: -1) }
                    .disabled(count == 1)
                Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") { change(by: 1) }
                    .disabled(count == Self.all.count)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.18), .teal.opacity(0.14)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private func change(by amount: Int) {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.55)) { count += amount }
    }
}

#Preview {
    RadialLayoutDemo()
}
```

## Subview Card Container

A custom container that styles each child of its ViewBuilder as a card.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/SubviewCardContainer/SubviewCardContainer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

extension ContainerValues {
    @Entry var subviewCardTint: Color = .accentColor
}

extension View {
    /// The color of the card this view gets inside a `SubviewCardContainer`.
    func subviewCardTint(_ color: Color) -> some View {
        containerValue(\.subviewCardTint, color)
    }
}

/// A container that turns every child of its `@ViewBuilder` into a tinted card.
///
/// `ForEach(subviews:)` sees each resolved child, so it works the same for
/// static views and for children that come from a `ForEach` or an `if`.
struct SubviewCardContainer<Content: View>: View {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    @ViewBuilder var content: Content

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: spacing) {
            ForEach(subviews: content) { subview in
                let tint = subview.containerValues.subviewCardTint

                subview
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .padding(16)
                    .padding(.leading, 6)
                    .background(tint.opacity(0.16), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                    .overlay(alignment: .leading) {
                        Capsule()
                            .fill(tint.gradient)
                            .frame(width: 5)
                            .padding(.vertical, 12)
                            .padding(.leading, 8)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
                    .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.9).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SubviewCardContainerDemo: View {
    private static let colors: [Color] = [.pink, .orange, .teal, .purple, .green]

    @State private var reminders = 1
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                    Text("Today")
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                    SubviewCardContainer {
                        Label("A static child", systemImage: "square.fill")
                            .font(.headline)
                            .subviewCardTint(.indigo)

                        Text("Plain text becomes a card too, with no wrapper around it.")
                            .subviewCardTint(.blue)

                        ForEach(0..<reminders, id: \.self) { index in
                            Label("Child \(index + 1) from a ForEach", systemImage: "bell.fill")
                                .subviewCardTint(Self.colors[index])
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(20)
            }

            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                Button("Remove", systemImage: "minus") { change(by: -1) }
                    .disabled(reminders == 0)
                Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") { change(by: 1) }
                    .disabled(reminders == Self.colors.count)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.1), .teal.opacity(0.1)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private func change(by amount: Int) {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.35)) { reminders += amount }
    }
}

#Preview {
    SubviewCardContainerDemo()
}
```

## Reorderable Card List

A stack of cards you can drag into a new order, without using List.

Category: Lists. Minimum: iOS 27.0. Path: Components/Lists/ReorderableCardList/ReorderableCardList.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A stack of cards the user can drag into a new order, without using `List`.
@available(iOS 27, *)
struct ReorderableCardList<Item: Identifiable & Sendable, Card: View>: View where Item.ID: Sendable {
    @Binding var items: [Item]
    @ViewBuilder let card: (Item) -> Card

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    card(item)
                }
                .reorderable()
            }
            .padding()
            .reorderContainer(for: Item.self) { difference in
                let destination: Item.ID? = switch difference.destination.position {
                case .before(let id): id
                case .end: nil
                }
                items = CardReordering.moving(difference.sources, before: destination, in: items)
            }
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)
enum CardReordering {
    /// Moves `sources` in front of `destination`, or to the end when it is nil.
    static func moving<Item: Identifiable>(
        _ sources: [Item.ID],
        before destination: Item.ID?,
        in items: [Item]
    ) -> [Item] {
        if let destination, sources.contains(destination) { return items }

        let moved = sources.compactMap { source in items.first { $0.id == source } }
        var remaining = items.filter { !sources.contains($0.id) }
        let index = remaining.firstIndex { $0.id == destination } ?? remaining.endIndex
        remaining.insert(contentsOf: moved, at: index)
        return remaining
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 27, *)
struct ReorderableCardListDemo: View {
    private struct Step: Identifiable, Sendable {
        let id: String
        let systemImage: String
        let color: Color
    }

    @State private var steps = [
        Step(id: "Design", systemImage: "paintbrush.fill", color: .pink),
        Step(id: "Build", systemImage: "hammer.fill", color: .orange),
        Step(id: "Test", systemImage: "checkmark.seal.fill", color: .green),
        Step(id: "Ship", systemImage: "paperplane.fill", color: .blue),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ReorderableCardList(items: $steps) { step in
            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                Image(systemName: step.systemImage)
                    .font(.title2)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .frame(width: 52, height: 52)
                    .background(step.color.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(step.id)
                    .font(.title3.bold())

                Spacer()

                Image(systemName: "line.3.horizontal")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .padding()
            .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)
#Preview {
    ReorderableCardListDemo()
}
```

## Reorderable Grid

A grid of tiles the user can drag into a new order.

Category: Lists. Minimum: iOS 27.0. Path: Components/Lists/ReorderableGrid/ReorderableGrid.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A grid of tiles the user can drag into a new order.
@available(iOS 27, *)
struct ReorderableGrid<Item: Identifiable & Sendable, Tile: View>: View where Item.ID: Sendable {
    @Binding var items: [Item]
    var minimumTileWidth: CGFloat = 100
    var spacing: CGFloat = 14
    @ViewBuilder let tile: (Item) -> Tile

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: minimumTileWidth), spacing: spacing)], spacing: spacing) {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    tile(item)
                }
                .reorderable()
            }
            .padding()
            .reorderContainer(for: Item.self) { difference in
                let destination: Item.ID? = switch difference.destination.position {
                case .before(let id): id
                case .end: nil
                }
                items = ReorderableGridReordering.moving(difference.sources, before: destination, in: items)
            }
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)
enum ReorderableGridReordering {
    /// Moves `sources` in front of `destination`, or to the end when it is nil.
    ///
    /// When `destination` is itself being moved, the first unmoved item after it is the anchor.
    static func moving<Item: Identifiable>(
        _ sources: [Item.ID],
        before destination: Item.ID?,
        in items: [Item]
    ) -> [Item] {
        let moved = sources.compactMap { source in items.first { $0.id == source } }
        var remaining = items.filter { !sources.contains($0.id) }

        let start = items.firstIndex { $0.id == destination } ?? items.endIndex
        let anchor = items[start...].first { !sources.contains($0.id) }
        let index = remaining.firstIndex { $0.id == anchor?.id } ?? remaining.endIndex

        remaining.insert(contentsOf: moved, at: index)
        return remaining
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 27, *)
struct ReorderableGridDemo: View {
    private struct App: Identifiable, Sendable {
        let id: String
        let systemImage: String
        let color: Color
    }

    @State private var apps = [
        App(id: "Music", systemImage: "music.note", color: .pink),
        App(id: "Photos", systemImage: "photo.fill", color: .orange),
        App(id: "Maps", systemImage: "map.fill", color: .green),
        App(id: "Mail", systemImage: "envelope.fill", color: .blue),
        App(id: "Notes", systemImage: "note.text", color: .yellow),
        App(id: "Weather", systemImage: "cloud.sun.fill", color: .cyan),
        App(id: "Books", systemImage: "book.fill", color: .indigo),
        App(id: "Health", systemImage: "heart.fill", color: .red),
        App(id: "Files", systemImage: "folder.fill", color: .teal),
        App(id: "Clock", systemImage: "clock.fill", color: .purple),
        App(id: "Camera", systemImage: "camera.fill", color: .gray),
        App(id: "Wallet", systemImage: "wallet.bifold.fill", color: .mint),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ReorderableGrid(items: $apps) { app in
                VStack(spacing: 8) {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 26)
                        .fill(app.color.gradient)
                        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
                        .overlay {
                            Image(systemName: app.systemImage)
                                .font(.largeTitle)
                                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        }
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)

                    Text(app.id)
                        .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle("Hold and drag")
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)

}
```

## Arc Segments Loader

A spinner with gradient arc segments of different lengths turning in opposite directions.

Category: Loaders. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Loaders/ArcSegmentsLoader/ArcSegmentsLoader.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Two rings of arcs with different lengths, turning in opposite directions.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the arcs stay still.
struct ArcSegmentsLoader: View {
    var colors: [Color] = [.pink, .orange, .purple, .pink]
    /// The length of each arc, as a fraction of the ring.
    var lengths: [Double] = [0.32, 0.16, 0.07]
    var size: CGFloat = 64
    var period: TimeInterval = 1.8

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var lineWidth: CGFloat { size * 0.075 }

    private var arcs: [ClosedRange<Double>] {
        let gap = max(0, 1 - lengths.reduce(0, +)) / Double(max(lengths.count, 1))
        var start = 0.0
        return lengths.map { length in
            defer { start += length + gap }
            return start...(start + length)
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
            let turns = reduceMotion ? 0 : context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate / period

            ZStack {
                ring(inset: 0)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(turns * 360))

                ring(inset: size * 0.2)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-turns * 360 * 1.4 + 90))
                    .opacity(0.7)
            }
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
        }
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel("Loading")
    }

    private func ring(inset: CGFloat) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            ForEach(arcs, id: \.lowerBound) { arc in
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: arc.lowerBound, to: arc.upperBound)
                    .stroke(
                        AngularGradient(colors: colors, center: .center),
                        style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: lineWidth, lineCap: .round)
                    )
            }
        }
        .padding(lineWidth / 2 + inset)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ArcSegmentsLoaderDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.black, .purple.opacity(0.6)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 40) {
                ArcSegmentsLoader(size: 260)

                VStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text("Preparing your trip")
                        .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)

                    Text("Comparing the best routes")
                        .font(.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
                }
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ArcSegmentsLoaderDemo()
}
```

## Blob Morph Loader

A soft gradient blob drawn in a canvas that keeps changing shape while content loads.

Category: Loaders. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Loaders/BlobMorphLoader/BlobMorphLoader.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and AwesomeSwiftUI contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A soft blob that keeps changing shape, drawn in a canvas.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, it shows one still blob.
struct BlobMorphLoader: View {
    var colors: [Color] = [.pink, .purple, .indigo]
    var size: CGFloat = 96
    var speed: Double = 1

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
            let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed

            Canvas { canvas, canvasSize in
                let blob = BlobMorphOutline.path(in: canvasSize, time: time)
                let shading = BlobMorphOutline.shading(colors: colors, in: canvasSize, time: time)

                var glow = canvas
                glow.addFilter(.blur(radius: canvasSize.width * 0.08))
                glow.opacity = 0.55
                glow.fill(blob, with: shading)

                canvas.fill(blob, with: shading)
            }
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
        }
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel("Loading")
    }
}

private enum BlobMorphOutline {
    static let pointCount = 16

    /// A closed curve through points whose distance from the center is a sum of moving sine waves.
    static func path(in size: CGSize, time: Double) -> Path {
        let center = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
        let base = min(size.width, size.height) * 0.31

        let points = (0..<pointCount).map { index -> CGPoint in
            let angle = Double(index) / Double(pointCount) * 2 * .pi
            let swell = 0.16 * sin(2 * angle + time * 1.4)
                + 0.10 * sin(3 * angle - time * 1.1)
                + 0.06 * sin(5 * angle + time * 0.7)
            let radius = base * (1 + swell)
            return CGPoint(x: center.x + cos(angle) * radius, y: center.y + sin(angle) * radius)
        }

        var path = Path()
        path.move(to: midpoint(points[pointCount - 1], points[0]))
        for index in 0..<pointCount {
            let next = points[(index + 1) % pointCount]
            path.addQuadCurve(to: midpoint(points[index], next), control: points[index])
        }
        path.closeSubpath()
        return path
    }

    /// A gradient whose direction turns slowly, so the color drifts across the blob.
    static func shading(colors: [Color], in size: CGSize, time: Double) -> GraphicsContext.Shading {
        let center = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
        let reach = size.width * 0.4
        let offset = CGSize(width: cos(time * 0.6) * reach, height: sin(time * 0.6) * reach)

        return .linearGradient(
            Gradient(colors: colors),
            startPoint: CGPoint(x: center.x - offset.width, y: center.y - offset.height),
            endPoint: CGPoint(x: center.x + offset.width, y: center.y + offset.height)
        )
    }

    private static func midpoint(_ first: CGPoint, _ second: CGPoint) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(x: (first.x + second.x) / 2, y: (first.y + second.y) / 2)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct BlobMorphLoaderDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.black, .indigo.opacity(0.7)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                BlobMorphLoader(size: 300)

                Text("Thinking")
                    .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)

                Text("Your summary is almost ready")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    BlobMorphLoaderDemo()
}
```
